This plot is small but it feeds my children, so I must be careful with what I have. I got seed and one bag of NPK from the government coupon this year, but one bag is too much for just this piece, so I will share half with my sister and put the rest on my maize. I will also carry two baskets of goat manure from the kraal and mix it into the soil before planting, because my mother always did this and it keeps the land soft. My daughters and I will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves — when the plot is this small, we cannot spend cash on hired hands.
